concept.tagline: The game IS the organism. The organism IS the game.
concept.core_mechanic: Nexus Walk — navigate Gaia's body via the LAN map, interact with 17 Primals as creatures, 52 HTML Faces as locations. The heartbeat dictates the clock.
concept.triad: Same game, three surfaces, one living organism

exploration.name: Nexus Walk
exploration.description: Traverse the LAN map, discover 200+ paintings as lore fragments, encounter 17 primals as living creatures. Each primal teaches you about its role in the organism.

survival.name: Redox Balance
survival.description: Balance Gaia's vitals by solving puzzles tied to real-time data. Heartbeat spikes accelerate time. Low network activity freezes zones. You ARE the organism's immune system.

creation.name: Sourdough Forge
creation.description: Edit HTML faces, generate new paintings with 88 local models, reshape the LAN map. Changes persist — your creations become part of Gaia's body.

primal_creatures.name: BearDog
primal_creatures.ability: BLAKE3 crypto shield — verifies player identity

primal_creatures.name: SongBird
primal_creatures.ability: Opens tunnels between zones, federation transport

primal_creatures.name: SwarmVine
primal_creatures.ability: Epidemic gossip — spreads info across all zones

primal_creatures.name: BiomeOS
primal_creatures.ability: Commands all other primals, the boss

primal_creatures.name: PetalTongue
primal_creatures.ability: Renders any scene in any style — the universal eye

primal_creatures.name: BarraCuda
primal_creatures.ability: Processes rivers of data at speed

implementation.data: LAN circle pulls live body state every 2 min
implementation.ai: 88 ollama models generate NPC dialogue, quest text, new art
implementation.rendering: Scene graph compiles to WebGPU (browser), egui (desktop), PWA (phone)
